description: Implement atomic rolling amount/count/quantity limit reservation and release semantics with an in-memory store implementation behind a port interface, designed for future PostgreSQL backing.
findings: LimitStore port interface defined with reserve/release/getCurrentUsage/getActiveReservations. InMemoryLimitStore uses per-bucket AsyncMutex for concurrency safety. Expired reservations lazily cleaned on access. High-concurrency property tests verify N concurrent reservations against limit N never exceed total.
